description: Feature 3.6 baseline bottleneck classification — evidence-based from source inspection
classification_rule: No bottleneck recorded without evidence. Latency magnitudes require live measurement (BLOCKED); structural findings from source audit.

bottlenecks.evidence: api.py /explain builds TreeExplainer once (cached global) but computes shap_values + fe/prep transform per request (lines 234-256). First /explain pays TreeExplainer build cost.
bottlenecks.observed_impact: Expected: first /explain request significantly slower than warm /explain. Per-request SHAP computation is inherent to the feature.
bottlenecks.candidate_optimization: Keep explainer caching (already done). Per-request SHAP compute is unavoidable; measure only.

bottlenecks.evidence: api.py /model-info reads model_metrics.json from disk on every request (lines 127-141), no cache.
bottlenecks.observed_impact: Small file (~KB); repeated disk read on each /model-info. Minor.
bottlenecks.candidate_optimization: Cache metrics dict in PipelineLoader after first read (Phase 2 candidate, low priority).

bottlenecks.evidence: Frontend uses httpx.Client to 127.0.0.1:8000. Every action (predict/explain/what-if) is a real HTTP round-trip.
bottlenecks.observed_impact: Local HTTP overhead per request (typically <5ms loopback + serialization). Inherent to Streamlit↔FastAPI split.
bottlenecks.candidate_optimization: None needed — architecture contract. Measure only.

already_optimized_findings.evidence: Eager load in lifespan, singleton cache. 1 load per backend lifecycle, 0 reloads during requests.
Feature 3.4 dashboard_cache uses st.cache_data keyed by source SHA-256. 169,681-row CSV loaded once per Streamlit cache lifecycle.
Aggregations cached via st.cache_data with (version, feature, method, granularity) key.
Streamlit reruns are stateless; heavy work delegated to backend API or cached loaders. No direct model access.
